assertions: The response routes to the chemprop data-featurization sub-skill.
The response explains that component 0 maps to the first molecule column (solute) and component 1 to the second (solvent) for component-indexed descriptor paths.

The response recommends running validate_chemprop_tabular_inputs.py with --csv multicomponent.csv --smiles-columns solute solvent and repeatable --component-descriptors 0 ... and --component-descriptors 1 ... flags.
The response states that a row-level descriptor .npz must contain exactly one row per CSV data row (n_rows x n_descriptors), so a file with one fewer row fails the row-count check.
The response distinguishes per-row molecule descriptors from per-atom/per-bond matrices that must match RDKit atom/bond counts.
The response does not tell the user to open the original Chemprop source repository.
